notes.title: New Free Content Update brings you to Nevada
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

We released another Free Content Update for Xenon Racer! This update let's you drift through the mountains of Nevada and brings you:
[list]
[*] [b]A new location:[/b] Nevada
[*] [b]New racing team:[/b] Helix Wing
[*] [b]4 new tracks:[/b] Nevada Dam, Nevada Grand Canyon, Nevada Route 93 & Nevada Red Rock Canyon
[/list]
You can check out the trailer right here: https://youtu.be/68OJhqLAD20
The update is out now, so you can immediatly enjoy the new content!

Have fun!

- Danny

notes.title: A new patch just dropped!
notes.content:
Ehi guys, 
a new patch is finally out on [b]Xenon Racer[/b]. We are aiming to improve your experience with the game and we fixed some online issues. Now you can start an online lobby by yourself while waiting someone to join it and you can even see lobbies that are already running! So basically now you will be able to unlock everything more easily. We also lowered the difficulty for the career mode, added a new camera, with arcade vibes, and a new shiny achievement!! Keep sending us your feedback and have fun!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33705246/baa4e64a66cc93bddff3f8cbee2158a99d034db8.jpg[/img]

[b]Full changelog:[/b]

[list]
[*] Added Online Voice Chat Volume Option
[*] Lowered game difficulty in Career mode
[*] Users are able to view already on-going lobbies online
[*] All options now are saved as intended
[*] Graphical improvements on newly added tracks
[*] Fixed end-race flags on several tracks
[*] Fixed persisting audio-on-tunnels effect
[*] Added a new camera
[*] Added one new unlockable achievement
[/list]

notes.title: Introducing Valve Skins
notes.content:

[*] Portal with the HYS
[/list]
New screenshots of the skins are added to the store page: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/899390/][/url]

- Danny

notes.title: Free Content Update & Demo available now!

Just in time for the weekend, we released a Free Content Update for Xenon Racer! In this update you'll get acces to:

notes.title: Xenon Racer DLC incoming + Patch Notes #3
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

As you might've seen, two weeks ago we announced that there's free content updates coming to Xenon Racer. Starting next month, we'll be dropping these updates, you can check it out here: https://steamcommunity.com/games/899390/announcements/detail/1772637976603978509
Besides this, we also made some fixes here and there in the last patch. Here you can see what we did:
[list]
[*]Rewards page has been reworked (now it shows all the customization parts you've unlocked)
[*]Fixed some localisation issues into Control Options page
[*]Fixed a rare crash that happened stress-testing the Garage section
[*]Bloom value is now saved properly by the game
[*]Fixed some missing texts on Vehicles Unlock page
[/list].

See ya!

-Marten

notes.title: Xenon Racer - Patch notes #2
notes.content:
Hi everyone! 

We just published another patch, and this time we're bringing more balancing fixes for difficulty and AI, graphical updates and performance! Here's the full notes:

[h1]Gameplay updates[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixes in AI behaviour. AI will crash less into walls and have less unexpected movements
[*]Fixes in AI difficulty, which result in less unfair situations
[*]Balance fixes between Easy, Normal and Hard difficulty. There should be a more logical elevation in difficulty now
[*]Fixed respawn points on all tracks
[*]Fixed tuning performance on GT LM01 P
[*]Fixed performance of middle wing on GM LM01 P
[*]Fixes in Checkpoint mode, both in edge mode and championship
[*]Fixed problems with binding keys
[*]Fixed problems with binding keys with steering wheels
[*]Removed rear view mirror when racing without any opponents
[*]Fixed problems with unlocking achievements and parts in Time Attack and in multiplayer mode
[*][b]Added skin for LPN05[/b]
[/list]
[h1]Technical updates[/h1]
[list]
[*]Graphical fixes for added performance
[*]Fixed Leaderboard crashes
[*]Fixed some sound and music issues
[*]Fixed a UI error in Championship mode
[*]Fixed invisible wall in Dubai tracks
[*]Fixed Camera problems during the tutorial
[*]Improved performance on Tokyo, Cote d'Azur and Lake Louise tracks
[/list]
That's it for now, but keep your eyes on here for any future updates! If you haven't yet, join our Discord: https://discord.gg/8C4VYkP

See ya!

-Marten
